GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Bit Slow Out .5 Lengths Settled Down 6th 6 Lengths 1200m 7th 7 Lengths 800m 8th 7 Lengths home turn Hard Ridden 3 Wide 7th Middle Of Track Kept Going Ok Straight # ran on ok/fair run

Jumped only fairly missing start 0.75 Lengths , Settled Down worse than midfield trailing 6.5 Lengths on fence, made no ground to Turn then hooked 3 Wide Straightening Up and Made Ground in Straight # missed the start
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Held up momentarily rounding the home turn.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped only fairly & Settled Down 6.5 Lengths on fence, railed to 5.5 Lengths turning, Held Up home turn , switched out-in-out looking for a run in Straight without ever getting a gap. Checked and blundered at 200m. Forget the run. # no luck in straight
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Bumped on jumping. Unable to improve approaching and rounding the home turn when held up on heels. Approaching the 200m was checked for a number of strides, and blundered, after improving onto the heels of a weakening runner. Unable to be tested when held up on heels for the remainder of the event.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped awkwardly missing start 1 length and Settled Down 8.5 Lengths 3 Wide , Drifted Back to 11 Lengths Two Wide turning, Made Some Ground in straight. [Stewards: Post-race vet exam revealed no abnormalities.] # never featured
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Began awkwardly. A post-race veterinary examination of the mare did not reveal any abnormality.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped awkwardly missing start 1 length and Settled Down 8.5 Lengths Two Wide , little change to 8 Lengths 3 Wide turning, steered widest (7-wide) Straightening Up and Made Good Ground down the centre of the track. [Stewards: Underwent pre-race vet exam. Cleared to start.] # ran on well
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Began awkwardly, shifted out and bumped a runner.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Settled Down Mid Field 6 lengths. got to outside turn 4 lengths. battled away # Even Effort
Slow out 1 length and Settled Down last 11 Lengths from the lead, Drifted Back to 12 Lengths turning, steered only 2-3 Wide Straightening Up and Made Ground in Straight # slow out/got back

Jumped only fairly and Settled Down 9 Lengths on fence, railed up to 5 Lengths turning, Two Wide rounding turn, steered Four Wide Straightening Up then got wider down the running, hit Lead centre of track at 140m and kept going to post. [Stewards questioned trainer re improved performance. Trainer advised its first two start this preparation were on heavy going which it does not appear to appreciate and at its last start it began only fairly, raced Wide throughout and was unable to sustain a finishing effort, whereas today it enjoyes a comfortable run early/middle stages, was able to sustain its finishing effort and appears to have appreciated the firmer track on its home track, the location of its only previous win.] # solid win
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Began only fairly. Unable to improve between the 600m & 400m when held up on heels. When quest re improved perf. tnr stated gelds 1st two starts this prep were on heavy going of which it does not appear to appreciate. Tnr added at recent start geld began only fairly & was obliged to race wide throughout, unable to sustain a finishing effort. Tnr stated today geld enjoyed comfortable run, from inside barrier, & was able to sustain a finsihing effort. Tnr added geld apprecatied firmer track conditions on home track.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped fairly. Not pushed early & raced Mid Field 3 Wide No Cover (3L from lead). Worked to hold ground midrace & pushed to quicken @ 500m. Pushed along Five Wide (4L from lead) on home turn. Weakened in straight. # Wide & struggled
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Began only fairly.  Raced three wide, without cover, in the early and middle stages. Bumped, and unbalanced, passing the 300m. Approaching the 100m was bumped wider.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: A bit slow out & Settled Down last on fence 7.5 Lengths from the lead, Drifted Back to 13 Lengths turning, steered centre of track Straightening Up , got wider as it went and did pick up 6 Lengths in Straight # got a long way back
Jumped Ok Settled Down well back 8 lengths. well back turn. Held Ground # Not Sighted
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: A pre-race veterinary of the mare, which had not raced for in excess of 150 days, passed it fit to race.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Slow out 1 length and Settled Down 8 Lengths on fence, railed up to 4.5 Lengths turning, Hooked Out to centre of track but improved only marginally in straight. [Stewards questioned rider re performance. Jockey stated it settled at the rear, travelled strongly early/middle stages, was held up on heels from straightening until shifting out near 200m but was then one-paced to the line and was unable to make any significant ground on the leaders and eventual quinella.] # slowly away
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: When questioned regarding the performance of the mare rider stated that his mount settled at the rear of the field and travelled strongly, behind a moderate tempo, in the early and middle stages. Rider stated that on straightening his mount became held up on heels and he was unable to place it under full pressure until shifting out near the 200m. Rider stated that after obtaining clear running his mount was one paced to the line and unable to make any significant ground on the leaders, and eventual quinella, from its rearward position.
